OUTVERTS are OUTLET adverts that are too big to fit in OUTBOARD!! If you send in an advert or any message that is too big for our OUTBOARD section then it will go in OUTVERTS.

There is NO CHARGE to our OUTLET readers (even if you only buy an occasional OUTLET). Adverts stay in OUTVERTS until:
1. Crowded off by new ones (you can re-apply),
2. You ask for it to be removed,
3. We consider it finished.

---

### OUTLET EXTRA 1

Contains the first 7 OUTCLASSES (best machine code for beginners ever!); JACKSOFT (m/code assembler); SINGLESTEP (run and display code step by step); COL80 (prints OUTLET text in up to 137 chars a line); OUTPRINT (prints 3 columns); OUTSTART (disassembler); UNITRANS+ (tape file to Disciple/Opus/Mdrive); TRANSBACK (Opus file to tape); OUTDEX (OUTLET index).

Only £3.50 from CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

---

### CLIPPER 1

This is a compilation of clip art images on tape, +3 disc or Disciple/+D disc and includes CLIP COMPOSER (lets you edit images by moving areas of the screen to other areas or to other screens to pixel position etc.), RTCLIP to add a large text to screens, and RTCLIPAID to let you type the large text like a simple wordprocessor.

The clip art is a compilation of over 50 screens, most with about six individual images of various kinds — PREVIOUSLY IN OUTLET, now with a show and print program.

Only £3.50 from CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

---

### CLIPPER 2 TO CLIPPER 8

Seven discs of clipart images FORMERLY AS SOLD BY TEACHERS PET SOFTWARE, and many of these screens will gradually appear in OUTLET over a long period.

They are currently available on Disciple/+D disc, most with about 70 screens each with one to six images. If we receive sufficient demand we shall consider making them available on +3 discs and possibly tape, but they will need to be in compressed format.

Each disc in the CLIPPER 2 to 8 series (state which numbers you want with order) is £3.50 from CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

---

### CATLOADER V.2!

This is the BEST Disciple/+D file-handler, being a much-improved version of the one previously in OUTLET. It is very much faster to CAT the disc and selectively copy files, copying files up to 30K without reset (no limit if Betados). It includes a text reader for quick scan and print of text files, and a screen loader and display (with border colour change) — all automatic — just press the keyletter to load BASIC, SCREEN$ or text!

All commands are with just one or two keys so it is the FASTEST and SIMPLEST of ANY file-handler we've seen! One or two drives; selected file delete; RENAME also does case change (e.g., "name.C" to "NAME.c").

Up to the full 80 possible files on any disc can be displayed on two pages (toggled by the SYMBOL key); BASIC programs are listed first and different filetypes are in different colours (which you can now customise to taste).

The new CATLOADER comes with a printed, easy-reference manual. It is on general sale at £6.99 BUT ONLY £3.50 TO OUTLET READERS!

A version for +3 is in OUTLET 33 (does not include RENAME or the colour-customisation of the +D version).

CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

---

### CATLOADER FOR PC LUNTER EMULATOR FOR PSEUDO-MICRODRIVE OPERATION!

This is our microdrive version of CATLOADER now available on PC disc for directly loading into and use by the Lunter Spectrum Emulator in Microdrive mode. The Lunter emulator is available from BG SERVICES (see OUTBOARD).

This version does not include file-copying or rename, but will enable you to easily load and delete individual files with a single keypress!

Ask for PC Emulator CATLOADER. Only £2.00 from CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

---

### SPECTRUM CLUB!!

2000 SPECTRUM TITLES AVAILABLE FOR HIRE (also games for sale).

Return 1st-class postage paid!

For a catalogue and further details... Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope to:

SOFTSELL  
32 Dursley Road, Trowbridge, Wilts, BA14 0NP  

The Softsell Shop is at 16 Church Street, Trowbridge. Tel: 01225 775446.

---

### FLEXIBASE SERVICES

"Software for Safety", 20 The Parklands, Droitwich Spa, Worcs. WR9 7DG. Tel: 01905 775840. +D, +3, Sam, PC. FREE Z80 Spectrum Emulator with PC versions.

#### ROADCRAFT TEST
Based on ROADCRAFT: police drivers' handbook — also used by the Institute of Advanced Motorists and the Advanced Drivers' Association of the Royal Society for the Prevention of Accidents for their Advanced Driving Tests. The test is of use to all drivers. 45 questions in random batches of 5 at a time. Large text and large YES and NO answers (latter with appropriate sound). Ideal for home and public show — bystanders can easily watch the proceedings and share the learning exercise. £6.

#### CYCLE CODE TEST
Text/graphic test with virtually all Highway Code's special requirements for cyclists. 45 questions in batches of 9, large text and large YES+NO answers (latter with appropriate sound). Ideal for home and public show, bystanders can easily watch progress and share the experience. £6.

#### SAFE TRAVEL
Quiz & Guide, converted from Suzy Lamplugh Trust leaflet. Education for all on how to recognise, deal with, avoid dangerous situations on foot, bicycle, car, taxi or public transport. Choice of subject information or random selection of 5 questions from chosen subjects for prompt user turnover at home, school, club or public events. £6.

#### HIGHWAY TEST
HIGHWAY TEST now available for all motorists and L drivers for the new theory part of driving test, with 96 random multiple choice questions on the motoring parts of "The Highway Code". Crown copyright data reproduced by permission of The Controller of Her Majesty's Stationery Office. Large text, sound, illustrations and score. For home, training & public show use. Spectrum +D/+3 & PC (Sam version under conversion).

Highway test includes full version of FLEXIPAGE, text/graphics author with multiple use: interactive, free format and automatic display for beginners to experts to compose your own exercises. Send SAE for full list. £6.

#### SAFE DRIVING VIDEO
Used successfully as a training aid by Driving Services fleet car drivers, this quality recording covers many aspects of their course "Defensive Driving" using various approaches, including the driver's eye view of the road during a running commentary from a former police advanced driver.

This video can complement the PC CD-ROM "Interactive Defensive Driving" or be used alone. Training videos tend to be expensive due to production costs. This one is reasonably priced at £35.

Flexibase Services, 20 The Parklands, Droitwich Spa, Worcs. WR9 7DG.

---

### 8 BIT — THE MAGAZINE FOR ALL 8-BIT COMPUTER USERS

Yes, if you've got a CPC or a SAM, a C64 or a PCW, a Spectrum, or whatever... if it has an 8-bit heart, 8BIT IS FOR YOU!

Fileswapping, Email, DTP, Best buys, sources of Software and Hardware, Repairers, Club News, etc.

Only £1.50 per issue. Bi-monthly.

From: Brian Watson, Harrowden, 39, High Street, Sutton, ELY, Cambs, CB6 2RA.

---

### TOMATO GIRL SERVICES

- **MULTIFACE POKES**: 28 page booklet, over 900 games covered.
- **+3 SERVICE MANUAL**: A5 replica of the one issued to service engineers.
- **MUSIC WRITER MANUAL**: Now in A5 booklet form to go with Garry Rowlands program, now PD.
- **EMULATE**: Spectrum text magazine on PC — now on +3/+2 format, various issues.
- **SPECTRUM REPAIR MANUAL (48K)**: Self-explanatory.

#### CLIPART COLLECTION
I have over 240 screens, but that's not important right now...  
I'VE ACTUALLY GOT 'EM ALL PRINTED in A5 booklet form. Just send £2 in coins and I'll send the book plus details of other services and prices for those items listed above, or just send an SAE.

B. Dowsland, 26 Elsie Street, Goole, E. Yorkshire, DN14 6DU.

1. Их не вытеснят новые (можно подать заявку повторно);
2. Вы сами не попросите их снять;
3. Редакция не сочтёт их завершёнными.

Включает первые 7 выпусков OUTCLASSES (лучший в мире курс по машинному коду для начинающих!); ассемблер JACKSOFT; SINGLESTEP (пошаговое выполнение и отображение кода); COL80 (печать текста OUTLET до 137 символов в строке); OUTPRINT (печать в 3 колонки); OUTSTART (дизассемблер); UNITRANS+ (перенос с ленты на Disciple/Opus/Microdrive); TRANSBACK (перенос файлов с Opus на ленту); OUTDEX (алфавитный указатель OUTLET).

Всего £3.50 от CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

---

### CLIPPER 1

Сборник клипартов на кассетах, дисках +3 или Disciple/+D. В комплект входят CLIP COMPOSER (позволяет редактировать изображения, перемещая участки экрана в другие области или на другие экраны с точностью до пикселя и т. д.), RTCLIP (добавление крупного текста на экраны) и RTCLIPAID (набор крупного текста как в простом текстовом редакторе).

Коллекция содержит более 50 экранов, на большинстве из которых представлено около шести отдельных картинок разной тематики — РАНЕЕ ВЫХОДИВШИХ В OUTLET. Теперь снабжено программой просмотра и печати.

Всего £3.50 от CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

---

### CLIPPER 2 – CLIPPER 8

Семь дисков с клипартами, РАНЕЕ ПРОДАВАВШИХСЯ КОМПАНИЕЙ TEACHERS PET SOFTWARE. Многие из этих экранов будут постепенно публиковаться в OUTLET на протяжении долгого времени.

В настоящее время доступны на дисках формата Disciple/+D; каждый диск содержит около 70 экранов, от одного до шести рисунков на каждом. При наличии достаточного спроса мы подумаем о выпуске версий на дисках +3 и, возможно, на кассетах, но для этого их придётся сжать.

Каждый диск серии CLIPPER с номерами от 2 до 8 (укажите нужные номера при заказе) — £3.50 от CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

---

### CATLOADER V.2!

ЛУЧШИЙ файловый менеджер для Disciple/+D — значительно улучшенная версия утилиты, ранее публиковавшейся в OUTLET. Каталогизация диска и выборочное копирование файлов стали намного быстрее; копирует файлы размером до 30 КБ без перезагрузки (без ограничений при работе с Betados). Включает текстовый просмотрщик для быстрого просмотра и печати текстовых файлов, а также загрузчик и визуализатор экранов (со сменой цвета бордюра) — всё автоматически: достаточно нажать клавишу с буквой для загрузки BASIC, SCREEN$ или текста!

Все команды вводятся буквально одной-двумя клавишами, что делает программу САМЫМ БЫСТРЫМ и ПРОСТЫМ файловым менеджером из всех, что мы видели! Поддержка одного или двух дисководов; выборочное удаление; функция RENAME умеет менять регистр букв (например, «name.C» в «NAME.c»).

До 80 файлов диска выводятся на двух страницах (переключаются клавишей SYMBOL); программы на BASIC перечисляются первыми, а разные типы файлов отображаются разными цветами (цветовую гамму теперь можно настроить по своему вкусу).

Новый CATLOADER поставляется с печатным кратким руководством. В розничной продаже программа стоит £6.99, НО ДЛЯ ЧИТАТЕЛЕЙ OUTLET — ВСЕГО £3.50!

Версия для +3 выходила в OUTLET #33 (не включает команду RENAME и настройку цветов из версии для +D).

CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.
